newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated muni sales total $44 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated muni sales total $44 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Scheduled negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $44 million in four offerings Thursday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
The largest issue is a $20 million Massachusetts issue through senior manager Lehman Brothers.
An additional two negotiated deals totaling $8.3 million are on Reuter's possible list, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
